description: This file defines the SawOscillator class, a subclass of SynthUnit, implementing a sawtooth waveform oscillator for a MIDI synthesizer. It provides methods to set pitch, frequency, amplitude, and scaling, and generates audio samples based on phase incrementation.

classes.name: SawOscillator
classes.description: A class representing a sawtooth wave oscillator for MIDI synthesis, capable of adjusting pitch, frequency, amplitude, and phase.

methods.name: setPitch
methods.description: Converts a pitch value to frequency and sets it.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets the oscillator's frequency and updates the phase increment.

methods.name: updatePhaseIncrement
methods.description: Calculates the phase increment based on current frequency and scaler.

methods.name: setAmplitude
methods.description: Sets the amplitude of the oscillator.

methods.name: setFrequencyScaler
methods.description: Sets the frequency scaler and updates the phase increment accordingly.

methods.name: incrementWrapPhase
methods.description: Increments the phase and wraps it within the -1.0 to 1.0 range.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the current sample of the sawtooth waveform.
